sources.note: The file hyg/CURRENT/hygdata_v41.csv of github.com/astronexus/HYG-Database at the commit the url names, 33,932,548 bytes, fetched at 2026-11-12T14:51:33Z. That repository is archived; HYG now lives at codeberg.org/astronexus/hyg, whose current version is v4.4. Read: id, hip, hd, hr, mag and the designation fields bayer, flam and con, with bf as a check; the README says they come primarily from the Yale Bright Star Catalogue, fifth edition, with Flamsteed numbers added from Wagman (1987).

producedBy.changes: The rows of the HYG catalogue that carry a Bayer or Flamsteed designation, each with eight of its columns as HYG gives them; the rows with no Hipparcos number, and one whose combined designation disagrees with its own parts, are listed apart with their reason; and the other columns are left out.

files.note: The Bayer letters and Flamsteed numbers of 3,303 HYG v4.1 rows, keyed by HIP number, evidenceKind 'catalog-derived'. Which tile row each HIP number names is in ../designation-links/links.json, ESA data under its own record. Changed from HYG: of its 3,321 rows with a Bayer letter, a Flamsteed number or a combined designation (bf), the 3,303 with a HIP number are kept in HIP order, each with eight of its fields as HYG wrote them (hip, flam, bayer, con, hd, hr, id, mag); the 17 without a HIP number and the 1 whose combined designation (bf) disagrees with its own fields are listed apart with their reason; the other fields are left out, and no value is altered.
